right_click_context_menus.notes: Shared owner-aware BVT glass/motion menus support exact RNA actions, animation/keying sets, selected value/driver copies, conditional file/asset actions, visible-object/active-rig Jump and existing-editor routing. Simple library property overrides (single/all, linked-value restore, transactional rollback) and scalar custom ID-property defaults/bindings now pass 5.1.2/5.2.2. Exact-build native clipboard/Favorites admission restored and regression protected. Hierarchy-wide ID overrides, complex/mandatory rules, new-window/Edit Driver and hidden/cross-mode Jump remain explicit gaps. Broader platform/theme/DPI qualification and exact-reference/motion acceptance remain open. See docs/CORE_CONTEXT_AUDIT.md and docs/CONTEXT_MENUS.md. Scalar custom driver clipboard and Favorites now share the admitted ID/path interfaces, with UTF-8 buffer bounds. Host-owned numeric shortcut registration supports typed values, dependency tags, stale/type guards and real undo/redo. Eight final 5.1.2/5.2.2 runtime runs pass; see custom-adapters-v1. Scalar custom Python menu contributions now receive genuine property metadata on exact admitted builds, including nested contexts, inline fields and own-field right-click menus; Assign Default is mapped. Eight runtime runs and 253 unit tests pass; see custom-contributions-v1. Other custom types/unmapped native operators remain explicit limits.

active_blender_theme.notes: Production default uses original BVT public widget RGB extraction, immutable bounded caches and shared semantic roles across basic controls, selection menus and all eight compound cards. Reference policy is explicit. Blender 5.1.2/5.2.2 live theme, unchanged data pixels and retained resource checks pass; exact theme-reference fidelity and broader runtime/platform qualification remain open.

liquid_glass.notes: Mandatory BVT shared backdrop, Gaussian strong blur, refraction/rim and finite motion for every translucent surface. Default embedded host and new shortcut capture use this material. Tint/opaque fallback is degraded and cannot count as parity. Exact generated-reference acceptance and broader theme/platform matrix remain open.

consistent_ui_scale.notes: 2026-10-29 correction: all current Canvas widget families use authored-font-to-host-font sizing; pointer/search/color/palette popovers share owner, clip and strong-glass sizing. Standard body 11 and section titles 12; cards normally 315 logical units wide. 39 captures per installed runtime cover 13 families at 1x/1.5x/2x; native text batching matches. Prior oversized presentation is superseded, historical references remain immutable. Final generated-reference acceptance, future controls and broader display/platform qualification remain open.

single_line_invocation.notes: Loader-independent panel adoption and owned dialogs, property-only popups, confirmations, enum search, callback menus/pies and direct wm.call_menu* routes are execution-tested on macOS arm64 5.1.2/5.2.2. Existing owned-menu keymap routing, RNA matching, test-modal invocation, chord-preserving restoration and menu-only consumers are tested. Original operator state, cancellation, undo, exact-property context menus and retained glass verified. Ordinary foreground hotkey dispatch still needs consumer QA. Native redo popups, flag-enum search, auto-keymap hints, indirect helper calls, strict RNA proxies and unqualified hosts remain explicit limits. No new visual acceptance. Real CamKeys dialogs, menu, exact Add to CamProps contribution/undo and lifecycle pass on both runtimes. Mixed compatibility is explicitly opt-in; PropertyGroup lists without stable consumer keys remain native. Advanced brush curves remain unsupported. See docs/CAMKEYS_MIGRATION.md. Follow-up closes CamKeys local stable-list identity and brush-falloff consumer gaps with strict one-line setup. Foreign/read-only identities and other curve modes remain explicit boundaries.
